headline: Sensex and Nifty Surge Over 1% as Foreign Flows and Lower Oil Prices Drive Market Rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Optimism regarding foreign institutional investor (FII) flows into Indian equities
Lower global oil prices boosting overall market sentiment
Positive corporate earnings results for the second quarter
Strong performance in the financial and automobile sectors
whatHappening: Sensex surged by over 1,300 points while Nifty 50 crossed the 25,300 mark
Tata Power reported a 32% year-on-year jump in Q2 net profit to ₹1,652 crore
ITC increased prices for its Gold Flake premium cigarette packs by ₹10
Investors added approximately ₹4.5 to ₹6 lakh crore in wealth during the session
summary: Indian stock markets rallied sharply with the Sensex gaining over 1,200 points and Nifty crossing the 25,300 threshold. The surge was driven by foreign flow optimism, lower oil prices, and strong Q2 results from companies like Tata Power. Investors gained significant wealth as major indices jumped nearly 1%, supported by broad gains in financials and autos.
